about: bindc's admission of a C header: a #define continued with a backslash-newline is spliced only where the splice cannot change the token stream, and a signed INTn_C takes a negated literal (OpenTUI v0.9.3, BINDC-OT).

mutants.name: bindc-continuation-refused
mutants.rule: A #define continued with a backslash-newline after a space is admitted (OpenTUI v0.9.3 opentui.h:2784).

mutants.name: bindc-continuation-ends-directive
mutants.rule: A spliced newline does not end the directive: the next line is the macro's body.

mutants.name: bindc-continuation-splits-token
mutants.rule: A continuation right after a token is refused: C would join that token with the next line's.

mutants.name: bindc-continuation-outside-directive
mutants.rule: A continuation outside a directive is refused.

mutants.name: bindc-continuation-after-line-comment
mutants.rule: A continuation after // is refused: C extends the comment over the next line.

mutants.name: bindc-intc-neg-refused
mutants.rule: A signed INTn_C takes a negated literal (OpenTUI v0.9.3 opentui.h:1458, INT32_C(-1)).

mutants.name: bindc-intc-neg-unsigned
mutants.rule: UINTn_C of a negated literal is refused.

mutants.name: bindc-intc-neg-value-dropped
mutants.rule: INTn_C(-n) is -n, as C pastes it.

mutants.name: bindc-intc-neg-spelling
mutants.rule: A constant's canonical spelling keeps the minus of INTn_C(-n).

mutants.name: bindc-record-kinds-none
mutants.rule: A value parameter whose struct begins other structs takes any of its record kinds (OpenTUI ot_buffer_draw).

mutants.name: bindc-record-kinds-without-size
mutants.rule: Only a header with a size field has record kinds: a struct that starts with another (fx_visit) is not a record of it.

mutants.name: bindc-record-kinds-with-pointers
mutants.rule: A struct that holds a pointer is no record kind: Go memory with Go pointers must not reach C.

mutants.name: bindc-record-header-size
mutants.rule: A record kind's header holds the whole record's size (struct_size is sizeof the complete record).

mutants.name: bindc-record-go-param
mutants.rule: The typed parameter of a record header is the interface of its kinds.

mutants.name: bindc-optional-go-param
mutants.from: Type: "*" + b.GoType(*p.Type.Elem), C: i, Class: q.Class})
mutants.to: Type: b.GoType(*p.Type.Elem), C: i, Class: q.Class})
mutants.rule: An optional value's typed parameter is a *S, so nil can pass NULL (OpenTUI's frame for an owned buffer).

mutants.name: bindc-optional-class-refused
mutants.rule: A contract exception may name a parameter optional.

mutants.name: bindc-optional-unfilled
mutants.rule: A non-nil optional value reaches C filled: its autofill fields (struct_size, abi_version) set.

mutants.name: bindc-record-ergo-param
mutants.rule: The Ergo extern of a record header takes the union of its kinds.

mutants.name: bindc-record-unfilled
mutants.rule: A record reaches C with its autofill fields set. (TestLive drives the golden package through C; TestGolden keeps the golden the emitter's output)

mutants.name: bindc-record-nil
mutants.rule: A nil record passes NULL (C answers FX_INVALID_ARGUMENT) instead of panicking. (TestLive drives the golden package through C; TestGolden keeps the golden the emitter's output)
